Description

Almost exactly one month after the release of the 2026 Chrome MLS Soccer Cards for Major League Soccer, North America’s top professional league, the significantly more limited Sapphire cards follow with their characteristic gemstone pattern.

Base Cards

The BASE SET features the same content as the main Chrome collection and includes the same 200 players, this time on blue shimmering Sapphire cards.

Insert Cards

Topps keeps things very minimal when it comes to the insert categories this time, adding only the INFINITE SAPPHIRE inserts to every 80th pack, which is equivalent to a Case Hit. Collectors will have to do without the Sapphire Selections that are otherwise typical of the Sapphire Editions in this collection.

Autograph Cards

The BASE AUTOGRAPH cards include exactly 1 Card fewer than in the main Chrome collection. There are no Autograph Cards of Justin Ellis (Orlando City SC) in the Sapphire Edition. Topps also keeps things limited to this single category for the Autograph Cards.

Availability

Each Topps Chrome Sapphire Major League Soccer 2026 box contains 32 cards, spread across 8 packs with 4 cards each. The Pack Odds indicate that these also include 1 Autograph Card per box.

The release date announced by Topps for 2026 TOPPS Chrome Sapphire Edition MLS Soccer Cards is Thursday, the 8th of October 2026. Short-term changes to this date are possible at any time and should be taken into account.

From that point onward, the boxes will be available from the Topps online shop.
